work.title: Untitled (Lips and Sports)
work.description: Flat-lay collage combines multiple cut paper elements across a yellow grid-patterned ground: three Rolling Stones tongue-and-lips logos, a soccer ball, a red American football helmet, and concentric-ring targets on a vertical stripe border at left. Layered transparent plastic sheets and paper scraps partially overlap the scattered components.
work.composition: scattered cut elements on grid ground
